what: UMB Financial is a Kansas City bank that lends to businesses across the Midwest, and runs large fee businesses in fund administration, corporate trust and healthcare savings accounts.
customers: Mid-sized businesses in the Midwest, plus institutional clients of its asset servicing businesses nationwide.
money: fund administration, corporate trust and HSA accounts
moat: Fee businesses such as fund administration and health savings accounts bring in deposits cheaply and earn fees that do not depend on the interest rate cycle.
risks: Commercial real estate exposure, as with every regional bank
The Heartland Financial acquisition has to be integrated without losing customers
opportunities: 9.7 times earnings with a 26.5% net margin and $7.8B of cash
Revenue grew from $1.6B to $2.7B last year as the acquisition came in
Analysts see about 25% upside, with 16 covering the stock
watch: Fee income growth and the integration of the acquired bank.
